summary: Create a rulebook activation under Automation Decisions > Rulebook Activations with name, organization, project, rulebook, credentials (Vault, AAP or custom types), decision environment (always pulled; pull policy cannot be changed) and restart policy (Always restarts up to 5 times, Never, or on failure).
questions: How do I create a rulebook activation?
Can I change the decision environment pull policy?
What restart policies do rulebook activations have?
Which credential types can a rulebook activation use?
